title: Classify full-column P104 wire entry and exact cleanup queries (no new κ)
body:
At the 11/19/487 wire meeting, prove the forced full-column entry, attain it with two ADDs, and classify the extra query needed to restore the helper. Minimum query support is eight; dyadic cleanup additionally requires a unit coefficient. A concrete collision rules out recovery from the three local observations alone. This completes local obligations left open by #6261's qualified response projection; it is not a counterexample to that claim.

Base: 2485805a6d47f36ea83ddde6327d453ac82d44dc.
#6261 source: 1866c2f3ee2d4cf5bf3e8f008883a6605ab10ed3. Exact input hashes: SOURCES.json.

Reproduce (Python 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-correlated-entry-completion
```
Expected: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

Executed: all 209 input columns; 15 query fixtures; exhaustive F3/F5 quotient cases 2673/70625 and correlated-Y F3 cases 24057; 97 rejection controls; normal/-O, source/history/mode/export and read-only Git-free checks. Wrong Y column, missing query, nonunit dyadic cleanup and actual source corruption reject. Fixed exhaustive domains; no random seed or unsearched region within them.

No new κ. This is a local interface, not a complete supplier. Correlated preparation, pure-query production, outgoing restoration, native implementation and a favorable complete invoice remain open; all five framework assumptions remain.

By @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance: worker B, independent boundary reviewer, worker C and lead review. Credit Nick Petalas (#6261), Matarener (#6217), DreamingOfClouds (#6170) and retained lineage. No human or proof-kernel acceptance claimed.

Proof, exact pins, controls and limitations: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/2f2cf0b227bc54ce0b95d165b5f90ec82d7c4686/research/p104-correlated-entry-completion
